items.docs: Search for merchants by name (fuzzy) or domain (exact match). Up to 20 queries per request. Each query carries its own `query_id` that is echoed back so callers can correlate responses. Each result contains an `items` array with matched merchants. Name queries return up to `limit` items per result (default 5, max 20). Misses return a single item with `id: null` — there are no 404s.

Retrieve ranked offer codes for a set of merchants. Up to 20 queries per request. Each result contains an `items` array of codes; misses return an empty `items` array. Add an `idempotency_key` to deduplicate requests; we suggest using `sha256(user_email + date)` or similar.
